title: Computable Ergodic Optimisation
summary: Links between physicals systems and computability properties have been an active field of investigation in recent years. Inspired by a previous work in the context of positive temperature Gibbs measures, we prove here that in the context of zero-temperature ergodic optimisation, for a computable potential and provided with several reasonable assumptions, the maximum ergodic average is a computable real number, and the set of maximising measures is a $Π_1$-computable compact set.
